name: LinkedIn Posting Text
description: Parses the plain text of a LinkedIn job posting's detail panel — select the panel (company through the About the job section) and paste it in. Reads the company/title/location header, the Remote/Hybrid/On-site and Full-time/Part-time badges, relative posted time and applicant count, and the job description, up to LinkedIn's own "Benefits found in job post" cutoff.
author: jsrothwell
